guide.start.1: Register as an Owner to create a shop, or as a Cashier using the shop code supplied by its owner. No email confirmation is required.
guide.start.2: Cashiers wait for owner approval. Sign in with your shop code, username and password.
guide.start.3: Choose English or Myanmar in the header. Open a shift before taking payments.
guide.shops.1: Select the shop name in the sidebar to see your shops.
guide.shops.2: Create a shop for another business or request membership of another shop using its code. The code for a new shop is generated automatically.
guide.shops.3: Hold or clear the current cart before switching. Products, stock and permissions belong to the selected shop.
guide.categories.1: Open Categories and enter a name to add a category.
guide.categories.2: Select Rename to change its name. Categories containing inventory cannot be removed.
guide.categories.3: Select a category name to open its products. Add or edit products from there.
guide.products.1: Open Products and select Add product. Choose its category and enter the product details.
guide.products.2: Configure product fields and create valid variants, such as Red / Small and Blue / Large. Enter each variant’s price, stock and image. Codes are generated when left blank.
guide.products.3: Open a product to view variants and edit their details. Only Owners can view or set costs and archive products.
guide.stock.1: Open Inventory to review quantities and low-stock alerts.
guide.stock.2: Use the stock adjustment control and enter a reason for receiving or correcting stock.
guide.stock.3: Edit selling prices in Products. Completed sales deduct the selected variant’s stock automatically.
guide.cart.1: In Point of sale, search for a product and select Add to cart.
guide.cart.2: Choose each option in order. Only valid combinations appear; image, price and available stock update with your selection.
guide.cart.3: Choose a quantity within available stock. Use Edit options on a cart line to change it. Different variants remain separate lines.
guide.sales.1: Open a shift and enter your opening cash. Add products and choose the customer if needed.
guide.sales.2: Take payment and select an enabled method. Split payment records more than one tender. Cash can produce change; non-cash amounts cannot exceed the total.
guide.sales.3: Confirm external transfers or card payments yourself, then select Complete sale. This app records payment; it does not transfer money.
guide.receipts.1: After completing a sale, review the receipt and use Print receipt.
guide.receipts.2: Choose your printer in the browser print dialog. Receipts use an 80 mm layout and support Myanmar text.
guide.receipts.3: Open Sales to review past transactions. Cashiers see their own sales; Owners can review shop sales and process returns.
guide.settings.1: Open Settings to upload a shop logo, set the shop name, tax and receipt footer, then save.
guide.settings.2: Your logo appears on receipts. Without a logo the shop name is used; Sayinn Hub remains a subtle footer mark.
guide.settings.3: Under Payment methods, add custom providers and choose enabled and cashier access. Used methods can be disabled, but cannot be deleted. Save changes before checkout.
guide.roles.1: Open Team to approve cashier requests or create a cashier.
guide.roles.2: Cashiers can sell, create and edit products, upload images and adjust stock. Owners manage categories, costs, settings, payments and team access.
guide.roles.3: Disable membership to remove shop access. An Owner of one shop can be a Cashier of another with different permissions.
guide.products.cashier: Use the existing product form to add valid variants and set selling price, stock and image. Ask an Owner to change field definitions or costs.
